## History

Irving had a failed engagement with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) in his past, but they eventually reconciled and were married in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), witnessed by their friends before being seen off at the station. Following the wedding, his wife returned to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), where they regularly hosted visits from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). During one summer visit, Irving's wife gently warned [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), advising her that they were meant for each other.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P1](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0001), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P6](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0006), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), +107 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Irving and [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were former lovers who reunited years after a failed engagement. Their long-standing romantic bond is rekindled through the help of his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading to their eventual marriage in the garden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Following their wedding, the couple settles into married life while maintaining a warm, supportive relationship with the friends who brought them back together.

- Romantically involved with — former lovers/reuniting suitors  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- Spouse of — to be married  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), +1 more</sub>
